dataset.duplicate_policy: Keep all images and original annotations; identical decoded RGB pixels stay in one split
dataset.difficult_policy: Include difficult and truncated objects as ordinary targets in every split; flags retained here, not in manifest schema 1
dataset.box_conversion: VOC one-based inclusive xyxy to zero-based normalized top-left xywh: [(xmin-1)/W, (ymin-1)/H, (xmax-xmin+1)/W, (ymax-ymin+1)/H]
dataset.split_method: sha256(seed:pixel_sha256) ranking within filename family; rounded test groups first, then validation; rest train
dataset.limitations: Custom split, not an official benchmark; exact pixels only, no acquisition/parent IDs; stratified by filename family, not all object labels; difficult objects are not ignored for evaluation
